title: LTX Officially Launches Open World Model LTX-2.5: Native Integration with ComfyUI and Free for Small and Medium Enterprises

content_html:
LTX, a company spun off from Lightricks, officially released the open weights video and world model LTX-2.5 today. The model is now available on Hugging Face and has formed a strategic partnership with ComfyUI for native integration, while also offering managed API services.

On the business model side, LTX adopts a tiered licensing strategy. Organizations with an annual recurring revenue (ARR) of less than $10 million can use it for free, while large enterprises need to negotiate for authorization. The series of models has already exceeded 33 million downloads so far.

LTX-2.5 features a deep reconfiguration of the generation pipeline, with core upgrades including: the introduction of a new diffusion video decoder to enhance details and image quality, support for native multi-camera single-pass rendering, the integration of a custom Gemma4 language backbone network, and specialized pre-trained checkpoints tailored for physical AI and robotics technologies. Thanks to NVIDIA optimization, its efficient distillation model can run cost-effectively on hardware such as RTX GPUs and Macs. Official data shows that the model's generation cost is approximately one-eighth of similar models, and the rendering speed is seven times faster.

Performance-wise, in self-hosted tests using two top-tier NVIDIA GB200 chips, LTX-2.5 generated a 10-second 720p video in just 6.8 seconds (faster than real-time playback); the quality blind test win rate reached 67%. LTX CEO Zeev Farbman stated that betting on open-source weights aims to attract developers through openness, and by taking the path of "local verification first, then commercial licensing," it precisely enters diverse enterprise-level application scenarios such as virtual production, real-time robotics, and edge computing.

content_html_zh:
从 Lightricks 分拆出来的公司 LTX 今天正式发布了公开重量视频和世界模型 LTX-2.5。 该模型现已在 Hugging Face 上提供，并与 ComfyUI 建立了本地集成战略合作伙伴关系，同时还提供托管 API 服务。

在商业模式方面，LTX采用分层授权策略。 年经常性收入（ARR）低于1000万美元的组织可以免费使用，而大型企业则需要协商授权。 该系列模型迄今为止下载量已突破3300万次。

LTX-2.5对生成管道进行了深度重新配置，核心升级包括：引入新的扩散视频解码器以增强细节和图像质量、支持原生多摄像头单通道渲染、集成自定义Gemma4语言主干网络以及为物理AI和机器人技术量身定制的专门预训练检查点。 得益于 NVIDIA 的优化，其高效的蒸馏模型可以在 RTX GPU 和 Mac 等硬件上经济高效地运行。 官方数据显示，该模型的生成成本约为同类模型的八分之一，渲染速度快七倍。

性能方面，在使用两颗顶级 NVIDIA GB200 芯片的自托管测试中，LTX-2.5 仅用了 6.8 秒就生成了 10 秒的 720p 视频（比实时播放更快）；质量盲测合格率达到67%。 LTX CEO Zeev Farbman表示，押注开源权重，旨在通过开放吸引开发者，走“先本地验证，后商业授权”的路径，精准切入虚拟生产、实时机器人、边缘计算等多样化企业级应用场景。
